versions.localizedDescription:
## Erosion-CN v1.0.4 (Build 29)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **System Compatibility / 系统兼容性提示**  
> - **Supported / 完整支持**：`iOS / iPadOS 27.0 – 27.2.1` and `27.3 beta 1` (`24C503*`).  
> - **Patched / 已封堵**：Apple patched `worse_query` starting in **`iOS 27.3 beta 2` (`24C5049d+`)**. Do **NOT** update past `27.3 beta 1` if you rely on Erosion-CN.

---

### What's New / 更新内容

1. **Non-Blocking Cold Start in Custom Lock Screen Wallpapers + `Camlo · 开幕` Guide (`PosterBoardView`) / 「自定义锁屏壁纸」零阻塞秒开与 Camlo 动态壁纸引导** *(Special thanks to [@iiichika](https://github.com/iiichika) for the thorough root-cause report in [#51](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/51) / 特别感谢 [@iiichika](https://github.com/iiichika) 在 [#51](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/51) 的详细根因排查)*
   - **Instant UI & Import Ready**：Removed the full-screen `isReady` gate so the `.tendies` list, bottom import button, and top-right menu load immediately without blocking on cold `PosterBoard` container discovery (fixing the ~39s+ blank screen on iPad / fresh installs).
   - **Background Lookup & Actionable Retry**：`com.apple.PosterBoard` container resolution now runs asynchronously in the background with an inline status/retry banner, and tapping **Apply** (`应用`) when unready shows an actionable **Retry Lookup** (`重新定位`) alert instead of silently staying disabled.
   - **Built-In `Camlo · 开幕` Companion Card**：Added a bilingual card at the top of `Custom Lock Screen Wallpapers` introducing our companion on-device dynamic wallpaper studio **[Camlo](https://github.com/Kianuni/Camlo)** (~9 MB, swipe-reveal transitions, Live Photo/video & 3D depth lock screens, 385+ free cloud & museum wallpapers, `.tendies` export) with direct GitHub access and a one-tap **Add Repo Source** menu for SideStore / AltStore / Feather.

2. **Fixed Horizontal Card Clipping in Splash Ad Blocker (`AdCacheBlockerView`) / 修复「开屏广告缓存精准锁死」概览卡片排版溢出** *(Thanks to [@wvcq6xxvkj-star](https://github.com/wvcq6xxvkj-star) for reporting [#52](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/52) / 感谢 [@wvcq6xxvkj-star](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/52) 反馈)*
   - Removed intrinsic `.fixedSize()` constraints on multi-button `HStack` rows inside inset-grouped cards and moved **Lock All Pending** (`一键全锁`) to a full-width prominent row button so both left and right edges stay cleanly inside card margins on Display Zoom, smaller iPhones, and Larger Text.
   - Wrapped per-item action rows (`Locate`, `Preview`, `Trash`, `Lock/Unlock`) in `ViewThatFits(in: .horizontal)` and tightened container header flexibility to prevent horizontal clipping across all screen widths.

> 📜 Full changelog / 完整更新日志：**[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)** · User Guide / 使用指南：**[USAGE_GUIDE.md](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/blob/main/USAGE_GUIDE.md)**

---
